topics.name: Human Documentation Builder
topics.purpose: Define deterministic generation of human-readable documentation from accepted canonical semantics.

semantics.source_rule: Exact accepted canonical snapshot is source.
semantics.localization_rule: Localized human labels may be applied through exact localization profile.
semantics.stale_rule: Source change marks generated docs stale.
semantics.write_rule: Builder writes only declared projection targets.

invariants.rule: Toolchain code, scans, indexes, reports and generated artifacts remain implementation/evidence surfaces; they never become canonical semantic authority unless an explicit accepted canonical definition says so.
Every toolchain execution binds exact bootstrap/source/profile/input revisions and must not resolve ambiguity through filesystem order, newest-wins, mtime, fuzzy names or UI layout.
